headline: KUN prop surges 27% on an 8.8σ volume spike while PF prop jumps 25% amid heightened unusual‑trading activity
market_take: Today's coverage shows mixed momentum across sectors. Construction stocks were pressured, highlighted by TRITN's -33.33% intraday drop. Property delivered the strongest upside with KUN up 29.63% (27.27% intraday) and PF up 25.00%, both accompanied by significant volume anomalies. Food displayed extreme moves, notably F&D's +52.25% rise on negligible volume and XBIO's -12.50% open gap tied to a clarification filing.

sector_notes.note: F&D surged +52.25% with virtually no trading, while XBIO opened down -12.50% after a SET clarification filing; AQUA also posted a -9.09% open gap.

KUN recorded a +29.63% gain (intraday +27.27%) on an 8.8σ volume spike; PF rose +25.00% intraday; JCK moved +8.33% intraday after a CB sign was lifted; A PROP and PRIN each showed -100% price gaps linked to connected‑transaction filings.
TRITN fell -33.33% intraday, while PLE and SOLAR posted intraday gains of +11.11% and +9.52% respectively; TPOLY experienced a -9.09% open gap.
NER posted a 4.5σ volume spike and TL recorded an intraday rise of +8.11%.
GEL saw a 4.7σ volume spike and VNG disclosed a related‑party transaction.
